payload: uint8 interleaved pixel-major12channels; each cell sum255
sampleConvention: 1024x1024 PixelIsArea cells; min coordinates are outer cell edges. Cell centre min+(index+.5)*spacing. Distinct from CDM1 node convention.
semantics: Area-coverage fractions of categorical classes in local projected plane, not physical canopy density, slope-surface area or exact geodesic area.
quantization: float64 exact rectangle overlaps; normalize only float64 closure residual; largest remainder rounding to sum255, tie order fixed channel order.
